response.answer: I take ownership of murky vendor incidents by separating verified contract facts from vendor claims, communicating the confirmed facts promptly, and holding back attribution until the supporting ticket export is available. I keep the evidence trail organized, correct record issues at the source, and use the resulting documentation to produce communications that can withstand review. This approach reflects a lesson from an earlier premature attribution that had to be retracted; since then, I have applied a clear rule not to attribute fault, verbally or in writing, before the export is in the folder. When the vendor expressly admits fault, I communicate that promptly.
